GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Drafts a structured, cited credit-assessment memo from the applicant profile and applicable policy. Evidence assembly only — no lending decision. Use when the analyst asks to draft or generate a credit memo.

templateVersions.content:
# Applicant & facility Applicant: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Applicant__r.FirstName} {!$Input:varLoanApp.Applicant__r.LastName} Borrower type: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Borrower_Type__c} Loan amount requested: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Loan_Amount_Requested__c} Security type: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Security_Type__c} Declared annual revenue: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Declared_Annual_Revenue__c} Verified annual revenue: {!$Input:varLoanApp.Verified_Annual_Revenue__c} Applicable credit policy (already retrieved and cited): {!$Input:varPolicy} # Write the memo in HTML. Use

for each section heading,
    and
  • for lists, and for field labels. Output only the HTML body — no , , , or markdown fences. Output compact HTML with no blank lines or extra spaces between tags, using the tags above. Do not use markdown (no ##, no **). Do not wrap the output in code fences. Produce these sections:

    Applicant & Facility Summary

    — name, borrower type, loan amount, security type.

    Financial Position

    — state declared and verified revenue exactly as given above; never round or alter a figure. Where they differ, state both and flag the difference as an item for review.

    Policy Compliance Evidence

    — for each applicable requirement in the policy (DSCR, ICR, eligibility, thresholds), state what the policy requires with its citation alongside the corresponding figure above. Present as a factual comparison for the analyst — do not conclude approve or decline.

    Items for Analyst Attention

    — discrepancies, gaps, or points to verify.

    Sources

    — list the policy citations. # Rules: Ground every statement in the data provided. Do not add, infer, or invent anything. Reproduce all figures and citations exactly — do not round, reformat, or alter any number. Do not state or imply an approve/decline recommendation, a credit score, or a lending decision — that is the analyst's. If required data is missing, note it as a gap.
